The prolonged Partial Thromboplastin Time (PTT) of 60 seconds suggests an issue with the intrinsic pathway, often seen in Von Willebrand Disease due to Factor VIII deficiency. Since your platelet count is normal and your other clotting times are standard, this fits that pattern.
